title: From First Steps to the Hillside
caption:
FIRST STEPS, HILLSIDES, AND QUIET GOAT MOMENTS. Separately filmed, genuine goat footage. #WildVox #Goats #AnimalBehavior

narration_timeline.text: Young goat kids stay near an adult, taking cautious steps across familiar ground.
narration_timeline.scene: Authentic newborn kids beside adult; no nursing claim

narration_timeline.text: Far away, a managed hillside herd spreads across the grass to graze.
narration_timeline.scene: Managed goat herd grazing on Sunnyvale hillside

narration_timeline.text: Other goats move over rocks, where each careful step keeps the group going.
narration_timeline.scene: Real moving goats on rocky ground

narration_timeline.text: Two separate recordings contrast goats feeding on hay with another resting in open grass.
narration_timeline.scene: Separate hay feeding and resting goat

narration_timeline.text: In a pen, movement slows as goats pause and groom, a different part of their day.
narration_timeline.scene: Real goats in pen and independently filmed genuine self-grooming; never assert yawning

narration_timeline.text: A lone goat stands outside in the grass, closing this look at different daily routines.
